# Bid the method, the thickness, and the extra work.

> Price an asphalt driveway from overlay, mill-and-overlay, or full-depth: square footage, thickness, street apron, failed base, and sawcut — not a published $3.50-a-square-foot special. See the mix tons and the walk-away number.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
